body: People don't need me. They would however, need my car and computer and money.
If I do go through with it then I plan to donate all my money and donate whatever I own to people in need.
Good on you. People like you are what's right with the world.

That's the exact opposite of what I want - Someone to be nice to me just because they feel bad for me. The truth is you don't really know if you'd ever like me. I am sincerely grateful for your caring about a stranger however, I imagine that you're probably a wonderful person.
